network.tdh.example.title: A TDH snapshot, step by step
network.tdh.example.intro: Explore a fixed illustration of how holding days, card rates, and collection boosts combine. The rates and rules below are illustrative and assume no other changes.
network.tdh.example.soldBoost: After the sale, the Nakamoto card and its 0.01 boost are removed.
network.tdh.example.roundingNote: Rounding: sum each card’s copy-days, multiply by its rate, round to 3 decimals, then to a whole number. Multiply that base by the boost, round each card’s result and add the results.
network.tdh.example.saleNote: Selling before the snapshot removes the Nakamoto card and its boost from the remaining collection.
network.tdh.example.futureNote: Choose +30 days to add 30 whole days to every copy, keeping rates, boosts and eligibility fixed.
